min.description: Fixed Y-axis minimum. Omit (along with `max`) to auto-scale to the data.

max.description: Fixed Y-axis maximum. Omit (along with `min`) to auto-scale to the data.

win.description: Time window shown, in seconds. Default 30.

step.description: Draws steps between points instead of straight connecting lines.

fill.description: Fills the area under the curve.
